prerequisites: Mastery of the form and use of the following grammatical points: verb tenses, modals, prepositions, adjectives and adverbs.
Ability to express oneself on simple scientific topics.

learning_outcomes.text: Identification and mastery of multidisciplinary vocabulary applicable to engineering sciences.
Ability to orally and in writing synthesize a research article in the student's chosen field of specialization.
Mastery of new key points of English grammar.
Develop a specific lexicon according to the desired field of specialization.
Identify the analysis tools and strategies necessary for oral comprehension of audio and/or video materials.

degree: Licence Sciences pour l'Ingénieur - parcours Mécanique (L3)
